pue.boundary: AWS global data-center operational fleet; not external-AI-specific. Regional table omits regions operating less than twelve months.
pue.basis: Issuer-reported historical operational PUE, not a design target. Metering separately measures facility and IT energy. Q2 AI fleet geographic/energy weights and cohort coverage not disclosed.
pue.aggregation: sum(facility_kWh)/sum(IT_kWh), equivalently sum(site_PUE*site_IT_kWh)/sum(site_IT_kWh). Do not average regional PUE equally. Public weights unavailable; no independent reaggregation claimed.

deployment_proxy.boundary: Illustrative US-region deployment only, not Q2 global AI fleet
deployment_proxy.basis: Low: Ohio/Oregon; base: disclosed North America aggregate; high: Northern California. Northern Virginia 1.15 lies within range. These historical regional operations do not characterize new AI-only campuses.

model.revenue_scope: External recognized AI compute within AWS, excluding noncompute services and internal Amazon workloads; Trainium/Inferentia and NVIDIA cohorts separated.
model.capacity_time_basis: Q2 has 91 days. sum(active_AI_IT_MW_by_cohort * active_days)/91, with physical utilization applied by cohort. No activation-dated active AI MW supplied; no reconstructed numeric denominator.

formulas.facility_conversion: facility_power/PUE only for matched boundaries; no PUE adjustment to already-IT MW
formulas.utilization_sensitivity: For fixed revenue and active IT capacity, effective-MW output varies as 1/u; billable occupancy is separate.
formulas.pue_sensitivity: For fixed facility MW, revenue/effective IT MW = annualized_revenue*PUE/(facility_MW*u)/1e6; for fixed IT MW PUE affects facility costs, not the IT denominator.
formulas.electricity_sensitivity: One continuously drawn IT MW costs 8760*PUE*USD_per_MWh per non-leap year. Historical US-region proxy gives $9,811.2/$9,986.4/$10,336.8 annual cost sensitivity to each $1/MWh. Not a nameplate utilization-to-energy model.

assumptions.basis: Quarterly run-rate convention; not a full-year forecast.
Do not transfer historical global or US-region proxy into Q2 AI fleet without energy weights and matching cohorts.
Reserved service may earn fees while physically idle; neither is disclosed as a matched fleet measure.

rejected_shortcuts: Do not add AI and Chips run rates; overlap and chip-business service mix are unquantified.
Do not treat >$25B AI run rate as Q2 recognized AI-compute revenue.
Do not divide period revenue by future 5GW/2GW deal ceilings, PPA generation, or chip counts without system power.
$100B/8/2000 gives $6.25M per stated MW-year mechanically, but is NOT a matched contract price: broader service scope, ramp and power boundary are unresolved.
Do not combine an energy-derived actual IT load with a second physical utilization discount.

token_economics.reason: No matching AWS realized token-price, token/task volume and open/proprietary revenue split. Usage growth with contract pricing pressure is qualitative, not a scoped Jevons test.
token_economics.exact_break_even_formula: For matched realized price decline d, volume growth needed = d/(1-d). No d estimated.

model.revenue_engine: External customers buy metered compute/storage/services, fixed-capacity terms, or managed model service. Isolate AI compute recognition and gross/net model charges; exclude internal Amazon workloads. Physical idle time may coexist with fixed-term revenue.

stranded_chips.reason: No matched cohort inventory, payment, acceptance, utilization and security/appraisal evidence. Secondary warehouse-staging lead is not a quantified primary observation.
taxonomy: accepted and billable but physically idle

replacement_and_financing.limits: Coupon is contractual GBP cost before hedge/fees/tax, not USD WACC or GPU cohort financing. General proceeds cannot be allocated wholly to AI.
replacement_and_financing.accounting_life: Subset shortened six to five years effective January 1, 2025; FY2025 incremental D&A $1.4B. Accounting estimate is not market economic depreciation.
replacement_and_financing.capital_carry_formula: For actual allocated capital C and matched rate r, simple delay carry C*r*delay_days/365; add storage/insurance separately. No numeric chip carry without funded cohorts.
replacement_and_financing.collateral_formula: Only for a verified secured pool: recovery=max(0, resale_value - remarketing_cost); shortfall=max(0, secured_debt-recovery). Contract cash-flow coverage and borrowing-base triggers assessed separately.
replacement_and_financing.software_read_through: TorchNeuron may lower switching friction and improve workload reuse; future rental rates/residual values need independent workload benchmarks and adoption data.
